prompt:
LTZZZ channel capability review. You review my measured matrix and answer three questions. You do NOT decide, do NOT dispatch, do NOT edit files. Public-distributable. No credentials, no amounts.

FORMAT
- Planner deepseek: ONLY JSON {"summary":"<=100 chars","tasks":[{"seat":"claude","task":"<=1500 chars"}],"needs_gpt_decision":false,"reason":null}. One task, seat claude.
- Worker claude: ONLY a table, columns: question | answer | evidence_ref. Max 8 rows, each cell <=25 words. No prose, no summary section, no tasks section.

EVIDENCE (measured on the Windows desktop today)
- DeepSeek native key1: deepseek-chat 200 in 1075ms, 19/22 tokens, no reasoning field; deepseek-reasoner 200 in 1852ms, 41/44+200 tokens, reasoning_content 563 chars.
- DeepSeek anthropic-compat endpoint https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1/messages: 200, text reply ok.
- api.anthropic.com POST: 403 "Request not allowed" (region policy). api.openai.com: TCP 443 not reachable.
- relay-proxy workers.dev and api.apisrouter.com: not reachable from desktop; relay only works inside GitHub Actions.
- Desktop configs: ~/.codex/config.toml default model gpt-5.6-sol plus a deepseek provider block (key plaintext); ~/.claude/settings.json env points at api.deepseek.com/anthropic with model deepseek-chat (key plaintext). Neither codex nor claude CLI is on PATH.

REF FILES (read-only, in repo)
- docs/2026-11-14-三通道接入与LTZZZ职能重排提案.md
- docs/2026-11-15-桌面GPT与Claude应用通道能力实测报告.md
- config/relay-seat-policy.json
- config/ai-providers.json

QUESTIONS
Q1 Which channel may be labeled native/official and which may not, per what evidence.
Q2 Where should each channel be used in LTZZZ duties, and which duty must never use channel 1 or 2.
Q3 What evidence is still missing before a GPT ruling on the three-channel split.
